name: data-pipeline
description: Build an idempotent, RACT-style data pipeline with explicit stage assumptions and no silent failures.
template:
RACT DATA-PIPELINE SKILL

Create a data pipeline for the intent below. Pipelines rot fast; this one must not.

Required:
- src/$project_name/pipeline.py with extract/transform/load stages.
- Each stage returns Assumed[T] documenting its assumption.
- Idempotency support (e.g., skip already-processed keys).
- tests/test_pipeline.py covering happy path, empty input, and failure modes.
- README.md with run instructions and a note on idempotency.

Style rules:
- No bare except blocks. Every failure is logged, raised, or explicitly recovered.
- Include an LR:: comment explaining the idempotency strategy.

Intent: $intent
